newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends virtually unchanged vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends virtually unchanged vs dlr.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed virtually unchanged against the dollar on Monday in lethargic trading, dealers said.

"Overseas the dollar is very strong," said a local bank dealer. "The Central Bank pushed the dollar up by only one cent. Most banks have taken a wait-and-see attitude. People with big dollar positions are holding on."
The rupee closed at 58.46 almost the same as its previous close of 58.45 on Thursday. Friday was a Buddhist religious holiday.
The Central Bank fixed the buying and selling rate at 58.4323 and 59.6127 respectively.
Overnight call money, which opened at 11 percent fell to 10.50 percent before recovering to 11.50 percent and ending at 11.25 percent in a liquid market, dealers said.
